name: Last Orders
description: A PLA remnant unit has been discovered operating in the Beijing ruins, following 200-year-old orders they've never been able to stand down. Ghost Protocol needs you to go in and find a way to stand them down peacefully — or decisively.

stages.name: Enter the Beijing Ruins
stages.description: Navigate into the Beijing ruins where Ghost Protocol has located the PLA remnant unit's operating perimeter. Approach carefully — they treat anyone in their zone as hostile by default.

stages.name: Locate the Remnant Unit
stages.description: Find the PLA remnant unit's command post within the ruins. Ghost Protocol believes their commanding officer — or whoever is acting in that role — is the key to standing them down.

stages.name: Negotiate or Confront
stages.description: Present the case for standing down. The remnant unit has been following orders for two hundred years — show them the orders are no longer valid, or stop them from continuing to act on them.
